name: BOOSTXL-SHARP128 display BoosterPack plug-in module
sources: User guide SLAU786 (August 2018: Figure 1 drawing, Tables 1 to 3, Figure 5 schematic); Sharp LS013B7DH03 specification ver 1.2 (power, clock); read 2026-10-07

columns.head: The screen: Sharp LS013B7DH03
items: Screen: 1.28 in, 128 x 128
Black and white memory LCD. Each pixel holds itself, no backlight
Power: about 4 uA holding a picture
12 uW typical at 3 V with no updates; 50 uW updating once a second (Sharp)
Speed: SPI up to 1.1 MHz
A full frame is about 2.3 kB on the wire, so about 18 ms
Limit: write only
The screen cannot be read back; the program keeps its own copy if it needs one

columns.head: Header pins it uses
items: SPI: 7, 15, select on 6
Clock and data; the screen's select is active high
GPIO: 2 power, 5 on/off
Pin 2 feeds the screen itself, so software can switch it off
SD card: 8, 14, 17
Card select, data back, card-detect
Not used: 19
EXTCOMIN is tied low on the board (R13 not fitted); software flips the VCOM bit instead

columns.head: On the board, and missing
items: On the board
microSD slot, a 3 V to 5 V converter (off), 0-ohm links R14 to R20 that move select and detect pins
Headers
40-pin BoosterPack connectors J1 to J4; works on 20-pin kits too
Not fitted
No touch, no backlight, no SD card in the box
Watch out
The 2 kB frame is larger than the LP-MSPM0C1104's 1 kB of RAM: draw line by line there
